description.en: Fades a screen out to white with CMND_WHITE_FADE_OUT and waits until CMND_IS_WHITE_FADE is false.
SCREEN_A (0, top), SCREEN_B (1, bottom) or SCREEN_AB (2, both).
Length of the fade in frames (EV_FADE_QUICK = 5, EV_FADE_NORMAL = 10, EV_FADE_SLOW = 15); 0 for an instant change.

examples.case: A white flash with a sound (real usage, from ev42111300.nut)
